messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: 2026-11-05T14:07:36Z ALERT: spike in 5xx and connection resets for inference-prod in eu-west-2a (az1a). Autoscaling not compensating for immediate failures.
ryan-oncall: seeing it. errors started ~14:05 UTC, client retries piling up. keeping pager open.
sanjeev-eng: digging into proxy & host logs. early signs point to NIC resets on a subset of g5 hosts in az1a. sample dmesg from host ip-10-0-45-67: 
```
[2026-11-05T14:05:12Z] ixgbe enp175s0f1: MAC Rx queue 3 timeout, resetting
[2026-11-05T14:05:12Z] ixgbe enp175s0f1: detected Rx ring full, dropping packet
[2026-11-05T14:05:13Z] kernel: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#7 stuck for 23s
```
maddy-sre: NLB health check history shows multiple targets in eu-west-2a flipping UNHEALTHY between 14:05-14:08. other AZs healthy. NLB logs: target 10.0.45.67 deregistered at 14:05:22.
olivia-plat: proposed immediate mitigation: 1) steer new traffic away from az1a via routing policy; 2) set maintenance for affected node pool to avoid new placements; 3) drain and cordon impacted hosts; 4) scale up warm capacity in eu-west-2b for headroom; 5) open AWS infrastructure ticket for host retirement/firmware. agree?
ryan-oncall: doing step 1 now: toggling routing-policy "az-fallback-eu2" to prefer b/c. applying — will take ~45s to propagate.
incident-bot: Routing policy change applied by ryan-oncall at 2026-11-05T14:08:10Z. Estimated convergence 60s.
sanjeev-eng: starting coordinated drain: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data ip-10-0-45-67` on hosts reporting NIC resets. Please avoid parallel mass drains — we need to ensure model serving capacity in targets.
maddy-sre: triggering Dedicated autoscale +4 GPUs in eu-west-2b and +2 in eu-west-2c to cover memory/KV pressure. ETA 8-12m. Also enabling cross-AZ KV cache warming to speed up cold-starts.
lee-cs: support queue flags: Acme.ai reported 50% timeouts since 14:06, BetaCorp seeing intermittent degraded throughput. Sending preliminary incident note to both (we'll escalate to a status update after we confirm AWS actions).
olivia-plat: created AWS support case #111223344: reported host-level NIC driver timeouts and Rx ring full across multiple hosts in eu-west-2a. Requested immediate host isolation and hypervisor inspection.
sanjeev-eng: collecting logs and attachments to s3://redwood-incident-logs/2799123456/ for postmortem. grabbing `dmesg`, `journalctl -u inference.service`, and NLB target health snapshots.
ryan-oncall: monitoring metrics: post routing-change 5xx rate across overall cluster drops ~80% in 90s. az1a still shows a slow tail of resets; traffic into az1a now ~5% of normal.
maddy-sre: placed node-pool `eu-west-2a-gpu-pool` into `maintenance=true` to prevent new placements until AWS confirms host replacements.
lee-cs: initial customer impact summary: window 14:05-14:09 UTC saw ~10-15% of production requests experiencing 5xx for eu-west-2 traffic. top affected customers: Acme.ai (critical), BetaCorp (high), GammaLabs (medium). Outreach sent.
olivia-plat: moving to INCIDENT SEVERITY = HIGH. scheduling a quick sync at 14:25 UTC to review AWS response & remediation timeline.
ryan-oncall: handing pager to sanjeev for ongoing coordination. I'll standby but removing primary pager.
sanjeev-eng: ack. I'll coordinate with AWS, infra, and customer success. action items logged in runbook.
aws-support-bot: AWS case 111223344 update at 2026-11-05T14:20:05Z: observed guest NIC firmware causing Rx ring overflow on EC2 hosts; recommending evacuation and replacement of affected hosts. ETA host replacement: 30-45 minutes.
maddy-sre: plan for recovery: 1) keep routing policy in failover mode until hosts replaced and NLB targets stable for 10m; 2) run canary traffic back into az1a after host replacement with reduced concurrency & mem-footprint routes; 3) run stress test on restored hosts to validate no kernel/NIC errors; 4) prepare customer post-incident with timeline and mitigations.
lee-cs: drafting customer postmortem and notification template now. will include mitigation steps and ETA for full restoration.
ryan-oncall: note: we saw transient increased socket backlog during the event—tuning kernel accept queue can help future bursts. added to follow-up RCA list.
sanjeev-eng: continuing to monitor. next update in 15m or sooner if AWS escalates. :mag:
